title: Factorized token x domain Mirror embedding address
hypothesis: A shared quotient/remainder embedding basis plus a small domain-specific Givens View can recover useful domain-specific embeddings for held-out token-domain combinations beyond tied composition and simple FiLM controls, without duplicating per-domain token tables.
physical_object: shared quotient and remainder partition embedding tables
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per domain, applied to each quotient/remainder pair
logical_multiplicity: 64 token ids x 4 domains = 256 logical embedding roles

model.data: Synthetic 64-token by 4-domain classification. The teacher uses shared 8D quotient/remainder vectors rotated by one domain angle. A seed-locked 25% of token-domain pairs is excluded from training; every token and domain appears in other training pairs. All methods receive identical examples and labels.

controls: shared quotient/remainder concatenation tied across domains
domain FiLM scale and bias on shared concatenated embeddings
domain additive 16D embedding vector on shared concatenation
shared quotient/remainder basis plus one Mirror Givens angle per domain
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent seen-pair accuracy >=0.80; Mirror seen-pair accuracy within 0.02 of the best non-independent control; Mirror held-out-pair accuracy >=0.05 absolute above tied concatenation; Mirror actual payload <=1.10x the smallest of tied concatenation/FiLM/additive controls and <=0.50x independent table; count unique serialized FP16 embeddings across all 256 token-domain roles; serialized-state CPU throughput >=0.90x the fastest simple shared control. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds pass quality, held-out transfer, actual bytes, uniqueness, runtime, and exact replay gates; Mirror improves the quality-byte frontier over tied and FiLM controls.
failure_gate: Any development seed misses a registered gate, or a simple shared control matches Mirror held-out quality at comparable/lower actual bytes. Fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload

boundaries: held-out token-domain pairs are not trained
256 role count is not independent capacity
fresh seeds remain closed unless every development gate passes
